_readme: Hand-edited inputs for scripts/build_data.py: content that is a judgment or a game rule, not data read from the .md files.
Values here are merged into KS_DATA as-is. A key that the .md parser also produces is an error (the build fails).
Field meanings: docs/SCHEMA.md. Keys starting with '_' are ignored.

rules.drillCamp: Slotted heroes auto-level to the lowest of the 5 instructors' levels (in-game text, 22 and 25 Oct and 5 Nov) and use no XP. Level Resets set a hero to Lv 1 and refund all their Hero XP (in-game text, 22 and 25 Oct). A hero removed from Drill Camp returns to its own level (community sources).
rules.oneMarchPerHero: A hero can be in only one march at a time.

skillBooks.text: Skill book counts (a/b on a skill's Upgrade button) are your shared stock of that book type, not progress saved on that skill. Each rarity has its own books: Epic heroes share Epic books, Mythic heroes share Mythic books, so books spent on one Epic hero are gone for every other Epic hero. Book type names are read from the icons.

redeemShards.text: The Redeem count on a hero's promotion screen is a shared stock of shards per rarity: Epic heroes share Epic Redeem shards, Mythic heroes share Mythic ones, so shards redeemed for one hero are gone for the others of that rarity. How many hero shards one Redeem shard gives is not recorded.

drillCamp._instructorNote: From the Drill Camp screen of 5 Nov: the 5 instructors all show Lv 64. The screen shows no names; left to right they look like Jabel, Chenko, Seth, Quinn and Diana, and these are exactly the five heroes whose own 5 Nov screens show Lv 64 without the Drill Camp message (Olive showed Lv 63 then, reaching Lv 64 later on 5 Nov, and Edwin Lv 59), so the identification is firm. Slot 9 needs Town Center Lv 23 and slots 10-15 are locked. On 27 Oct the instructors were Jabel 64, Diana 61, Olive 59, Chenko 59 and Quinn 64, so slotted heroes ran at Lv 59.

recommendations.what: Rallies: save the free fourth march preset as "Join", led by Chenko, for joining other players' rallies (Terror, Bear)
recommendations.why: A march joining someone else's rally adds only one skill to it: the first (top) expedition skill of its lead hero; its second and third heroes only add troops. The rally leader gets all three skills of each of their heroes. Guides rank Chenko, Yeonwoo and Amane among the best joiners and say Chenko's and Yeonwoo's skills add together when both join the same rally. Jabel is a poor joiner: her Rally Flag is chance-based, and several Jabels count only once. Chenko's top expedition skill is Stand of Arms, +20% Lethality for all squads since it reached Lv. 4 by 5 Nov (+20% is the old Lv. 4 preview), and she is in none of the Be, Att or Gat presets (5 Nov). Yeonwoo's On Guard gives the same +20% Lethality since it also reached Lv. 4 by 5 Nov (old Lv. 4 preview); Amane's Tri-Phalanx (+15% Attack) stays capped until her 3★. Terror is rally-only, and you have a fourth march queue (4 / 4 on 5 Nov). The Deploy screen shows preset tabs 4, 5 and 6 after Be, Att and Gat; they were not opened, so whether a Join preset already exists is not known. Troops: for Bear Hunt, guides give a joiner an Archer-heavy march (10% Infantry, 10% Cavalry, 80% Archers in two guides; 10 / 30 / 60 for Generation 1 heroes in a third) and say a full march matters more than the exact ratio. A full Join march holds 88,880 (Chenko, Helga and Yeonwoo add 12,730 each, like your other presets), but you have 43,180 Archers (5 Nov), less than 60%, so the suggestion keeps 10% Infantry, sends every Archer and fills the rest with Cavalry. For Terror, a rally guide gives 50 / 20 / 30.

changes.note: One hero per troop type, as in your other presets; Yeonwoo can lead instead when Chenko is busy

Save the Bear Hunt split in the preset and change it on the Deploy screen before a Terror join (or the other way round if you join Terror more often). The numbers assume no other march is out: if one is, keep 10% Infantry, send every free Archer and fill the rest with Cavalry

steps: Deploy → a free preset (4, 5 or 6): Chenko first (lead), Helga and Yeonwoo in the other two places; troops 8,888 Infantry, 36,812 Cavalry and 43,180 Archers (all your Archers) = 88,880; name it Join.
Before joining a Terror rally, change the troops to 44,440 Infantry, 17,776 Cavalry and 26,664 Archers (50 / 20 / 30).
When you join a rally (Terror, Bear), send Join; keep Att for rallies you lead.

Diana (lead: -18% stamina, +60% hunting march speed) and Gordon (+15% squad Attack and Health) stay. Helga is the closest swap: she is also infantry, so the troop mix stays the same, and she adds Echoes of Valhalla (+10% squad Attack) and Oath of Guardian (16% chance to halve damage taken). Her hero power is lower (306,455 vs Forrest's 438,984 on 5 Nov), so test it before keeping it.

steps: Deploy → Be → remove Forrest → add Helga → Save.
Hit the same beast level you use now and compare troop losses with an earlier hunt.
Keep whichever loses fewer troops.

recommendations.what: Long term: Mythic shards and books to Jabel first; Epic investment to Howard, Quinn and Diana, plus Chenko or Yeonwoo as the rally joiner; Helga and Saul last for combat
recommendations.why: Jabel is your only Mythic hero in the combat line-ups (Att, both Arena squads, Barricade 1), and community guides call her the easiest Generation 1 Mythic to build without paying; she reached Tier 5 by 5 Nov and is 64 shards from 4★ (36 / 100). Guides rank Amadeus as the strongest Generation 1 hero, but he is not recruited (0 / 20) and they say he mostly comes from paid packs. Guides call Helga pay-to-win and rank Saul lowest of the Generation 1 Mythics in combat; Saul's value to you is Resourceful (now Lv. 3: +9% construction speed, −9% cost). Among your Epic heroes, a 2026 list rates Howard and Quinn highest and Diana for beast hunting. Guides also say Generation 2 heroes (Zoe infantry, Hilde cavalry, Marlin archer) arrive around kingdom day 37–50 and Generation 3 around day 105–120; one guide advises building Jabel until Generation 3 rally heroes arrive. You have none of the Generation 2 heroes yet (28 Oct), which suggests they have not reached your kingdom, though it is also possible they are out but not yet earned (inferred).
steps: Mythic shards: Jabel to 4★ (36 / 100 on 5 Nov, needs 64; 36 Mythic Redeem in stock) before Helga (0 / 5) or Saul (0 / 40 to 3★).
Mythic books: Jabel's Youthful Rage and Persistence reached Lv. 4 by 5 Nov; their next level presumably waits for her 4★ (inferred). Not Saul's.
Amadeus: collect his shards from free events when offered (0 / 20 on 22 Oct); buying him only makes sense if you plan to spend.
Epic shards and books: Diana, Quinn and Howard first, then the rally joiner (Chenko or Yeonwoo); Fahd and Amane are in no combat line-up.

Generation 2: you have no Zoe, Hilde or Marlin yet (28 Oct), so Generation 1 heroes are still your best options; check the Hero Roulette and Hall of Heroes events for them, and when one appears, ask for an updated plan.
evidence: hero.md promotion screens: Jabel 3★ Tier 5, 36 / 100 to 4★ (5 Nov); Helga 0 / 5 (5 Nov); Saul 2★ Tier 5, 0 / 40 to 3★ (5 Nov); Amadeus 0 / 20 to recruit (22 Oct)
